_rules: One entry per YouTube video. Facts come from Bob's own descriptions and from corrections by Mackenzie and Bob; nothing is invented. 'made' says what is real and what was added; where a description says nothing about it, 'generic' is true and the line is the channel-wide one (Sam's own summary of the method). 'onSite' allows 'I recorded this at ...'. 'confirmed' becomes true only after Bob or Mackenzie confirms the video's facts on the review page; only confirmed videos are uploaded to the queue. Hooks: 48 characters at most, no colons, true for the video, never the same pattern twice.
